## Purpose
The editor for an agent's guardrails: Mistral moderation categories with thresholds, and switches.

## Responsibilities
- `GuardrailEditor({value, onChange})`.
- `emptyModeration` gives the default config. `activeVersion` picks the moderation version.
- Per-category inputs and switches cover the categories of `GuardrailCategoryThresholds` (sexual, hate_and_discrimination, violence_and_threats, dangerous, criminal, selfharm, health and others).

## Key elements
